title: MÁV Signal
description: Adds 2 MÁV signals, IntercIty and MÁV-START
body:
# MÁV Signal
Adds two redstone-powered blocks that play the iconic MÁV (Hungarian State Railways) departure jingle when activated.

## Blocks
MÁV Signal: The standard MÁV announcement chime. Plays when it receives a redstone signal, and emits a note particle so you know it fired.

MÁV Intercity Signal: The Intercity variant of the jingle, with a blue color scheme.
Both blocks are found in the Redstone creative tab.

## Crafting
MÁV Signal:
IRI
RNR
IRI

MÁV Intercity Signal:
IRI
BNB
IRI

*(I = iron ingot; R = redstone dust; B = blue dye; N = note block)*

## Notes
* Requires a pickaxe to drop
* Works on both client and server
* Volume is configurable
